prompt:
The snippet snippets/preorder-notice.liquid does not parse and is incomplete. Rewrite it so it parses under strict Liquid and renders a pre-order notice. Inputs (top-level, always supplied): - `product`: object, never null, with keys: - `product.title`: string, never null - `product.preorder_message`: string or null - `product.variants`: array (possibly empty) of objects, each with keys: - `title`: string, never null - `inventory`: integer (can be zero or negative) - `preorder`: boolean - `ship_date`: string or null A variant QUALIFIES when `preorder` is true AND `inventory` is less than or equal to 0. Rules: 1. If no variant qualifies (including an empty array), output nothing (empty string). 2. Otherwise output exactly, with no whitespace between or around tags and no leading or trailing whitespace: `

Pre-order: TITLE

    ITEMS
MESSAGE
` - TITLE is product.title HTML-escaped with the escape filter. - ITEMS: one `
  • ` per qualifying variant, in array order, but at most the first 3 qualifying variants (non-qualifying variants do not count toward the limit). Each item is `
  • VTITLE - ships DATE
    • ` where VTITLE is the escaped variant title and DATE is the ship_date with surrounding whitespace stripped, then escaped. If ship_date is null or empty after stripping, the item is `
  • VTITLE - ship date to be announced
    • `. The separator is space, hyphen, space. - If more than 3 variants qualify, append one final item `
  • and K more
    • ` where K is the number of qualifying variants minus 3. - MESSAGE: if preorder_message, after stripping surrounding whitespace, is non-empty, output `

    MSG

    ` with the stripped message escaped; otherwise nothing. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/preorder-notice.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
